trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies. The platinum is the last one you will get: finish the story, the character finales, the activities and the collectibles, then reach 100% completion. Follow this guide's roadmap and it unlocks on its own.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, and see it through to the end. Follow the on-screen objectives; this is the first story mission and it introduces the controls. It cannot be missed — story missions can be replayed from the pause menu.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. Play through the story in order; the trophy pops when the chapter's last mission ends. It cannot be missed.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. Continue the story in order; the trophy pops at the chapter's end. It cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. Keep playing the story in order; the trophy pops at the chapter's end. It cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4. This is the last chapter before the finale; the trophy pops at its end. It cannot be missed.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final story mission. Play through Chapters 1 to 4 first; the finale unlocks after Chapter 4. It cannot be missed — replay it from the mission list if you need to.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. It is a story mission; follow its objectives to the end. Replayable from the mission list.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. It is a story mission; follow its objectives to the end. Replayable from the mission list.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. It is a story mission; follow its objectives to the end. Replayable from the mission list.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. It is a story mission; follow its objectives to the end. Replayable from the mission list.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. It is a story mission set around the airport; follow its objectives to the end. Replayable from the mission list.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. It is a story mission; follow its objectives to the end. Replayable from the mission list.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. This is the long one: it counts story missions, activities, collectibles and side content together. Use the in-game checklist in the pause menu to see what is left; this guide's tracker covers the trophies and the game tracks the rest. It is the last gold before the platinum.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts. Stunts are jumps, near-misses, drifts and airtime in vehicles — the game counts them as you drive. Just drive fast and recklessly through Vice City and Leonida; the counter climbs on its own. Check your count in the stats menu.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types once: racing, fishing, the shooting range, the arcade, bowling, drone races, meditation, hunting and more. Visit each activity's location and start it once; you do not need to win, just try it. Use this guide's activity list to tick them off.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Go to a shooting range, pick a challenge and beat its gold time or score. Practice the weapon handling first; the range shows the gold threshold for each challenge. All 42 must be gold.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Find the Top Fun drone race markers, race the course and finish first at each of the 14 spots. Learn each course's turns before going for the win.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Enter races around Leonida — street races, off-road, boat and air races all count — and finish first in 20 distinct ones. Each race only counts once, so vary your picks.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal at a fishing spot and accept his challenge, then out-fish him: watch the line tension, reel steadily and do not let the line snap.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. Find an arcade, pick any game and play it to its end. You do not need a high score — just finish it.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Play Andy's mission strand to its end; his missions unlock as the story progresses. Replayable from the mission list.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Play Kenton's mission strand to its end; his missions unlock as the story progresses. Replayable from the mission list.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Play Billy's mission strand to its end; his missions unlock as the story progresses. Replayable from the mission list.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Look for the stranger markers on the map and play each strand to its end. There are more than 8 strands, so you can pick the ones you like.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Play Randy's mission strand to its end; his missions unlock as the story progresses. Replayable from the mission list.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Play Tyrone's mission strand to its end; his missions unlock as the story progresses. Replayable from the mission list.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. Find the meditation spots (marked on the map once discovered) and meditate at each one. They are spread across the state, so work through them as you explore.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal for Bret. Take Bret's hunting mission, track the unique animal to its area, and take it down. Use a scoped rifle and stay downwind so it does not spook.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Find cards hidden around Leonida — in shops, on tables, in glove boxes — and collect full sets. There are more sets than the 3 you need, so finish the easiest ones first.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK It is the in-game photo and sharing feature: open it at scenic spots, landmarks and viewpoints and post from each. The counter tracks distinct locations, so keep moving to new places.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges are the small tasks the game offers — races, stunts, hunting, collectibles and more. Any 50 count, so do the ones you enjoy and the counter climbs.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Get a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then lose the cops together — break line of sight, hide, and wait for the stars to clear. MISSABLE: do it while your partner is available in the story; once the partner leaves, the window may close.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. With your partner beside you, rob three shops in a row — keep the wanted level active between robberies and do not get caught. Plan a route with three close shops. MISSABLE: do it while your partner is available; it may not be possible later.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive or enter 100 distinct vehicles — cars, bikes, boats, planes and more. The game logs each new vehicle the first time you get in it, so try everything you see.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate Combat Focus during a firefight, then drop five enemies before it ends. Pick a fight with a group, use cover, and aim for headshots to make each shot count.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA (the airport). Get to the airport, grab a plane or helicopter, and take off without following the normal departure — just leave. Any aircraft works.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Deal with Rhinos (tanks). Get into a Rhino tank yourself or take one down — either way, engage with a Rhino. Tanks appear at high wanted levels and around military areas.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: avoid the cameras and the staff's sightlines, take the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm. Do it at night and move slowly.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Hit five different bank vaults and get away clean each time. Plan your escape route before you go in — a fast car parked nearby helps.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Find an armored truck on the road, stop it, take the cash and get away before the cops close in. A sticky bomb or a ram works to stop it.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Drive through every named area on the map — the game marks each one as discovered when you enter it. Work through the map region by region so none is missed.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Find each gang's illegal operation on the map, hit it and get out. There are 9 gangs, so you need 9 hits — one per gang.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to a bar or beach spot on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take in the view. It pops once the drink is served with the ocean in front of you.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car through a vehicle showroom's window and out the other side — the classic GTA move. Any showroom works; pick one with a clear exit.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play bowling at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Go to the alley, start a game and follow through — finish the game. You do not need a high score.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership moment with mass appeal. This is tied to a story beat with your partner — play through the story and it pops at the right moment. It cannot be missed if you finish the story.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make choices (PSN tracks a count to 500). The game tracks your choices — dialogue picks, mission approaches, side decisions. MISSABLE: some choices only appear once, so make them when they are offered; the counter climbs toward 500 over a full playthrough, but a choice you skip may not come back.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try. Fail something, then succeed at it on your next attempt. The easiest way: fail a mission or an activity once, then pass it on the retry.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange. This is a hidden or random event — a UFO, a cryptid, or something equally odd somewhere in Leonida. MISSABLE: it is easy to walk past, so explore the strange places (the swamps, the desert, the deep ocean) and it will find you.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by. Drive past someone and hit them with a melee weapon from the vehicle. A bat or a crowbar works; line up the pass and swing as you go by.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists; take them to your contacts to launder them into clean cash. Keep laundering until the total hits $250,000.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy clothes, weapons, food, car mods — anything in any shop counts. The total is cumulative, so it builds up naturally as you play; big purchases (cars, weapons) speed it up.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Buy every garage on the map — they are the properties that store your vehicles. You need enough cash, so save up or do a few heists first.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the Scooter Bros app on your phone, register a vehicle, and repeat for 10 different vehicles. Any vehicles you own or find work.

roadmap.title: Play the story
roadmap.detail: Chapters 1–4, the final mission and the story missions, in order. Nothing here is missable — missions can be replayed.

roadmap.title: Character finales and partner trophies
roadmap.detail: Finish the mission strands for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone, and the 8 stranger strands. Do the two partner trophies (Hot Together, Retail Therapy) while your partner is with you — they are the missable ones.

roadmap.title: Activities
roadmap.detail: Races, the shooting range, fishing, the arcade, bowling, drone races, hunting, robberies and the odd jobs. Most are cumulative counters; make story choices when they are offered (Actions Speak Louder) and keep an eye out for the strange event (The Truth Is Out There).

roadmap.title: Collectibles
roadmap.detail: Meditation spots (18), card sets (3), WAiNK It locations (100), vehicles (100), areas of Leonida (52) and garages (8). Work through them region by region.

roadmap.title: 100% and the platinum
roadmap.detail: Mop up whatever the in-game 100% checklist still shows, reach 100% completion, and the platinum pops.
